description: Reads back a registered Open Design artifact: its manifest, entry file content, supporting file list, and the user's unaddressed comments from the browser preview or VS Code ('openComments', status open or sent). Each comment names its element (selector, text excerpt, htmlHint, rect) and its note; up to 4 comment screenshots are attached as images, newest first, and every comment's screenshot path is listed. Call it when the user says they left comments; address each one, then pass their ids as resolvedCommentIds to register_open_design_artifact.

entryPath.description: Workspace-relative path to the artifact's entry file.

name: get_open_design_artifact
